title: Effect of monothiophosphinic acid and phosphine sulfide impurities on the solvent extraction behavior of bis(2,4,4-trimethylpentyl)dithiophosphinic acid from sulfate and methanesulfonate media
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1357-1367
